notes: GAAP. Governmental receipts/disbursements from the governmental funds statement (p4) Total Governmental Funds column; lease financing 37,616 + subscription financing 376,926 as debt_proceeds; beginning fund balance as previously reported 147,115,764 with the printed prior period adjustment 197,542 in adjustments (restated 147,313,306). Roll-forward ties to ending fund balance 109,777,132. ending_cash = governmental funds Balance Sheet cash and investments 104,697,061 (p3); no beginning cash printed. Business-type from the proprietary statement (p6) Total column (Landfill, Stadium, Sewer); business-type disbursements total 5,028,672 is printed on the Statement of Activities (p2); receipts total is operating + nonoperating revenues added. Rolls forward to 34,815,336. Taxes and Local are broad lines without a breakdown that ties (Statement of Activities property taxes and assessments 80,265,477 is government-wide), kept as taxes / intergovernmental (Local, printed under Intergovernmental; as FY2024) with review. Statement of Activities prints a governmental prior period adjustment 516,368 (governmental_net_position.restatement); no business-type restatement. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), lines by Governmental / Business-type columns, totals from the Total column; balances. Detail: cash-basis budget schedules for General (pp8-9), Road (p10), ARPA (p11) and nonmajor special revenue funds (p12: revenue and transfer lines printed only for all nonmajor funds together, expenditure rows are individual funds and carry that fund name); zero (dash) lines omitted (Payroll Accrual, E911 Sinking, Visitors Improvement, OPIOID Settlement Fund, Federal Forfeiture - County Attorney, SCAAP, Social Security Incentive, Road transfer out, ARPA revenues). Nonmajor receipts/disbursements by fund (p13) not itemized to avoid double counting with p12 (its 14,676,804 / 14,269,433 include transfers). Business-type statement-column detail removed (aligned with FY2024: governmental funds have their own budget schedules, user rule 2026-10-28). Read pages 1-13 of 13
